latest.title: Build an Image Analysis App Using Amazon Rekognition
latest.description: Want to build an AI-powered application that can understand images? In this hands-on tutorial, you will learn how to build an image analysis backend using Amazon Rekognition, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, and Amazon API Gateway. The application will analyze uploaded images, identify objects and scenes, and return detected labels with confidence scores. This project is designed for beginners who want to explore artificial intelligence and cloud computing with AWS

trending.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Tutorial: Build and Deploy Your First AI Agent
trending.description:
Building an AI agent is straightforward. Running it securely and reliably in production is the harder part.

An agent needs somewhere to execute, a way to access tools, permissions to call models, and visibility into its behavior. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore provides managed services for these operational needs.

In this tutorial, you’ll build a simple Python agent, test it locally, and deploy it to AgentCore Runtime.

trending.title: Amazon ECS Gateway Explained: A New Approach to ECS Ingress and Platform Engineering
trending.description: Amazon ECS Gateway simplifies ingress management by enabling platform teams to standardize networking while giving application teams a self-service way to expose their ECS services. Explore what ECS Gateway provisions behind the scenes, how service routing works, key architectural considerations, and what to validate before rolling it out. Less manual configuration, fewer operational bottlenecks, and a better developer experience.
